title: Lena and the House
author: Dominic Thackeray
blurb: Theo Thackeray, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
